name: Contacts / CRM
description: A CRM workspace over Chatfuel contacts: a record table with saved views, nested AND/OR attribute filters and inline editing, a full record page, a Fields surface over the bot's attribute catalog, an audience breakdown, and CSV import and export. Routes between the two list engines — the one that sees every contact and the live one that only sees contacts with a conversation — and says which one answered.

permissions.requiredFor: reading the contacts table, the record page, the field catalog, the audience counts and any CSV export
inline editing, name, note, sales stage and owner changes, bot-wide field defaults, and the CSV import
